summary.zh: 让物料绕过障碍、穿过交叉点，持续抵达机器入口。
summary.en: Route materials around obstacles and across junctions to keep machines supplied.

summary.zh: 把有限输入分给多台机器，避免一边吃撑、一边断粮。
summary.en: Divide limited input among machines without starving one branch.

summary.zh: 为混合物流设定规则，让不同物品自动走向正确出口。
summary.en: Assign routing rules so mixed items reach the correct destinations.

summary.zh: 把上一道工序的产出变成下一道的输入，逐级制造复杂物品。
summary.en: Turn one process output into another input to manufacture complex products.

summary.zh: 通过管线、泵与分支把液体送到正确设备。
summary.en: Use pipes, pumps and junctions to deliver fluids to machines.

summary.zh: 让发电、储能与负载保持匹配，避免扩产拖垮整座工厂。
summary.en: Match generation, storage and load so expansion does not cripple the factory.

summary.zh: 让机器根据温度、库存或其他信号自动启停。
summary.en: Make machines start and stop in response to temperature, stock or other signals.

summary.zh: 把重复搬运交给飞行单位，再围绕覆盖、能源和吞吐重新规划。
summary.en: Delegate hauling to flying units, then plan around coverage, energy and throughput.

summary.zh: 把验证过的生产单元保存下来，快速复制并适配新场地。
summary.en: Save a proven production module, then replicate and adapt it elsewhere.

summary.zh: 给不想要的产出找到去处，避免它把主产品生产一起堵停。
summary.en: Find a destination for unwanted outputs so they do not stall the main product.

summary.zh: 建得高、伸得远之前，先找到能够承受结构的支点。
summary.en: Find adequate support before building taller or extending farther.

summary.zh: 用围合空间和指定设施，把普通地块变成有功能的房间。
summary.en: Turn enclosed space and required fixtures into a functional room.

summary.zh: 直接改动高低与地面形状，为建筑和水流创造条件。
summary.en: Reshape elevation and ground for buildings and water.

summary.zh: 让关键设施覆盖更多需求，同时减少无效重叠。
summary.en: Reach more demand with facilities while reducing wasted overlap.

summary.zh: 建筑摆下去不等于能工作，还要让人和货到达入口。
summary.en: A placed building needs reachable access for people and goods.

summary.zh: 平面放不下时，把功能层叠起来，再解决上下连接。
summary.en: Stack functions when land is scarce, then connect the floors.

summary.zh: 把墙、地板等部件对齐接口，快速拼出可编辑结构。
summary.en: Align walls and floors at snap points to assemble editable structures.

summary.zh: 先画计划，再让工人按资源、通路和紧急程度落地。
summary.en: Plan first, then build according to resources, access and urgency.

summary.zh: 通过阻挡与放流改变水位，把水变成可管理的地形资源。
summary.en: Use barriers and release to manage water as a terrain resource.

summary.zh: 把热源、冷库和生活区分开，让布局参与温度管理。
summary.en: Separate heat sources, cold storage and living areas to manage temperature through layout.

summary.zh: 每多打一刀，都在花掉下一次闪避的余量。
summary.en: Every extra attack spends part of your escape budget.

summary.zh: 把防御从持续按住，变成一次有风险的时机判断。
summary.en: Turn defense into a risky timing decision instead of a held state.

summary.zh: 不只离开危险区，也能在正确瞬间穿过攻击。
summary.en: Avoid damage by timing a brief safe window, not only by moving away.

summary.zh: 先持续施压制造破绽，再把破绽兑换成高价值攻击。
summary.en: Build pressure first, then convert the opening into a valuable strike.

loop.en: Cash in with a critical hit

summary.zh: 同一个敌人，不同命中位置会改变攻击价值。
summary.en: Where a hit lands changes its value against the same enemy.

summary.zh: 攻击局部目标，永久削减敌人的能力或取得专属掉落。
summary.en: Damage a local target to change enemy capabilities or earn specific rewards.

summary.zh: 安全不是一个地点，而是相对于敌人射线的关系。
summary.en: Safety depends on enemy firing angles, not simply occupying a spot.

summary.zh: 技能不仅打人，还能改写脚下的战场。
summary.en: An ability can transform the battlefield as well as damage a target.

loop.en: Exploit or avoid the new area

summary.zh: 不仅要求打赢，还用即时评价推动玩家尝试不同招式。
summary.en: Reward expressive attack variety alongside simply winning.

summary.zh: 每次出牌既解决眼前问题，也改变下一轮抽牌结构。
summary.en: Playing a card solves the present while shaping the next draw cycle.

loop.en: Draw or reshuffle the next hand

summary.zh: 先看到去不了的地方，再用新能力重新理解旧地图。
summary.en: See an unreachable place, then reinterpret it with a new ability.

loop.zh: 发现当前无法通过的路

summary.zh: 把墙从边界变成可连续借力的移动节点。
summary.en: Turn walls from boundaries into reusable movement anchors.

loop.en: Catch the next wall or platform

summary.zh: 让一次跳跃通过有限位移资源，串成一整条空中路线。
summary.en: Chain an airborne route through a limited movement resource.

summary.zh: 把看似连续的墙面，拆成一段段可承受的攀登。
summary.en: Break a continuous wall into climbs the character can afford.

summary.zh: 选锚点、积累速度、适时放手，把空间变成运动路线。
summary.en: Choose an anchor, build speed and release into a new route.

cases.gameZh: 消逝的光芒2：人与仁之战

summary.zh: 把高度兑换成水平距离，并在途中寻找续航机会。
summary.en: Convert altitude into horizontal travel and look for ways to extend it.

loop.zh: 修正方向或借上升气流

cases.gameZh: 消逝的光芒2：人与仁之战

summary.zh: 地图不是开局全知，而是需要主动获取的探索成果。
summary.en: Make map knowledge something earned through exploration.

summary.zh: 第一次路程保留探索，重复路程逐渐转化为网络选择。
summary.en: Preserve the first journey, then turn repeated travel into a network choice.

summary.zh: 被看见并非立刻失败，警觉阶段为玩家留下处理窗口。
summary.en: Being noticed need not mean instant failure; awareness stages create response windows.

name.zh: 随机地形下的路线判断

summary.zh: 每局都要重新判断怎么走，而不是背熟同一条最优路。
summary.en: Read a new route each run instead of memorizing one optimal path.

loop.zh: 带着规则经验进入下一层
loop.en: Carry rule knowledge to the next level

summary.zh: 先获得做法，再把现有材料变成新的行动选项。
summary.en: Acquire a recipe to turn familiar ingredients into new options.

loop.en: Cook it and unlock its use

summary.zh: 满足配方条件即可换料，把稀缺材料留给更重要的用途。
summary.en: Swap ingredients that satisfy a recipe and save scarce items for other uses.

summary.zh: 熟了不等于完成：必须在过火之前取走。
summary.en: Food must be removed after cooking but before it burns.

summary.zh: 把一道菜拆成有先后关系、可并行准备的工序。
summary.en: Split a dish into ordered steps with parallel preparation opportunities.

summary.zh: 不只做得快，还要判断哪张单值得先做。
summary.en: Decide which order deserves attention first, not only how fast to cook.

summary.zh: 把半成品交到对的人手里，比每个人各做一道菜更有效。
summary.en: Handing off components can outperform every chef doing a whole dish.

loop.en: Pass it or use a buffer

summary.zh: 根据下一段活动配餐，而不是永远吃数值最高的一道。
summary.en: Choose meals for the next activity rather than always eating the biggest number.

summary.zh: 花时间和设施容量，把即将过期的食物变成远征储备。
summary.en: Spend processing time and capacity to turn perishables into travel reserves.

summary.zh: 把配方中的数字变成手上需要控制的分量。
summary.en: Turn recipe quantities into amounts the player must physically control.

loop.en: Choose a container or portioning method

summary.zh: 同样能吃的食物，也要按评判标准决定做成什么样。
summary.en: A valid dish still needs to satisfy a particular evaluation target.

summary.zh: 看得到的资源，不一定能用现在的工具带走。
summary.en: Visible resources may remain inaccessible to the current tool.

summary.zh: 花费道具或基础设施，把寻找资源从盲搜变成定位。
summary.en: Spend items or infrastructure to turn blind searching into localization.

summary.zh: 资源不是一个按钮，而是埋在可改变地形里的体积。
summary.en: Resources occupy alterable terrain rather than a single interaction button.

loop.en: Collect material and keep an exit

summary.zh: 每多拿一件东西，都在压缩安全返程时间。
summary.en: Every extra pickup consumes part of the safe return window.

loop.en: Fill oxygen and choose a route

summary.zh: 数量目标已经达成，接下来这一镐还值不值得？
summary.en: The quantity target is met: is another swing still worthwhile?

loop.en: Keep gathering or stop and return

summary.zh: 途中补充继续采集所需的弹药、能源或生命。
summary.en: Gather the supplies that keep the expedition itself running.

summary.zh: 读懂地表痕迹，再挖出藏在下面的收获。
summary.en: Read surface traces, then uncover what lies beneath.

loop.zh: 挖开标记处或周围岩层
loop.en: Dig at the mark or through nearby rock

summary.zh: 把已经有用途的物件拆成材料，获得资源也失去设施。
summary.en: Turn useful objects into materials, gaining resources while losing infrastructure.

loop.en: Compare materials with its current use

summary.zh: 记住资源何时回来，把地图变成有节奏的采集路线。
summary.en: Remember when resources return and turn the map into a timed harvesting route.

summary.zh: 去更深不一定更好，先确定你缺哪一种矿。
summary.en: Deeper is not always better; first decide which material you need.

summary.zh: 赢了以后选一张牌，也可以为了稳定抽牌什么都不拿。
summary.en: Choose a reward card after a win, or keep the deck consistent by taking none.

loop.en: Test it in the next encounter

summary.zh: 不扩大牌库，而是挑一张值得反复使用的牌进行强化。
summary.en: Improve a card you already own instead of enlarging the deck.

name.zh: 这一战只用一次的强牌
name.en: Powerful cards spent for the fight

summary.zh: 先打出强力效果，代价是这场战斗后面再也抽不到它。
summary.en: Take a powerful effect now, losing access to that card for the rest of the fight.

loop.en: Decide whether to spend the card

summary.zh: 把最关键的准备步骤放进首回合，换取开局的稳定性。
summary.en: Guarantee an essential setup card at the start of a fight.

summary.zh: 保留快要成形的组合，用有限换牌次数修补缺口。
summary.en: Keep a promising combination and spend limited redraws to complete it.

summary.zh: 复制不只是多一张牌，也能把此前的强化一起复制出去。
summary.en: A duplicate can multiply the value of upgrades already invested in a card.

summary.zh: 用一张牌或一个单位，在这一战里制造额外的行动材料。
summary.en: Use a card or unit to create extra action cards within the current fight.

name.zh: 同样的效果，换顺序结果不同
name.en: Ordering effects to change the result

summary.zh: 先加再乘，或先挂弱点再攻击，把顺序本身变成决策。
summary.en: Add before multiplying or expose a weakness before attacking: sequence becomes a decision.

name.en: Two competing uses for one card

summary.zh: 把攻击和移动放在同一张牌上，选一个用途就放弃另一个。
summary.en: Put two useful actions on one card so using one sacrifices the other.

loop.zh: 比较一张牌的两种用途

loop.en: Cover the missing role with another card

name.zh: 把掷出的结果分配给行动

summary.zh: 骰子先告诉你这回合有什么，再由你决定把它们用在哪里。
summary.en: Roll first, then decide where each available result will do the most good.

loop.zh: 查看能用的槽位或目标

loop.en: Resolve and prepare the next roll

name.en: Using card patterns as action requirements

summary.zh: 同一手扑克可以凑成不同组合，用哪一组决定你能做什么。
summary.en: The same hand can form different patterns, determining which actions become available.

loop.en: Assign a group to the current goal

name.zh: 拿到改规则的被动后重组玩法

summary.zh: 新被动不只加数值，还改变哪些组合成立、哪些牌值得留下。
summary.en: A passive changes which combinations are valid and which cards are worth keeping.

loop.zh: 检查现有牌的价值变化

loop.en: Build a loop around the exception

name.zh: 信息分开，靠描述拼起来

summary.zh: 一人看现场，一人拿线索，只有讲清楚才能一起解决问题。
summary.en: One player sees the situation and another holds the clues; clear descriptions connect them.

loop.zh: 报告结果再处理下一项

summary.zh: 目标不同的人混在一起，行动既要获利，也要经得起别人观察。
summary.en: Players with opposing goals share a space, balancing progress against looking suspicious.

summary.zh: 把每个人只看到的一小段事实，变成一次全体承担后果的决定。
summary.en: Turn partial individual observations into a decision whose consequences affect the group.

summary.zh: 伙伴失去行动力后，队伍要拿眼前的安全换回一名战力。
summary.en: When an ally falls, trade immediate safety for restoring a teammate.

summary.zh: 同一艘船的转向、防守与维修都要人做，队员必须不断商量谁先忙什么。
summary.en: A shared vessel needs steering, defense and maintenance, so the crew keeps reallocating jobs.

summary.zh: 绳子把两人的移动连在一起，伙伴既能拉你上去，也会被你拖下去。
summary.en: A tether links movement: a partner can pull you upward or be dragged down with you.

loop.en: Choose who anchors and who moves
Jump together or swing for momentum

summary.zh: 两处开关必须同时满足，走到位置之后还得对上行动时机。
summary.en: Two separate controls must be active together, making timing matter after everyone reaches position.

loop.zh: 找到需要同时满足的条件
检查结果再进入下一段

summary.zh: 每个人擅长不同事情，搭配顺序比谁单独最强更重要。
summary.en: Different strengths make the order of teamwork more important than individual power.

loop.en: Choose who sets up the situation
Let the partner use that setup

summary.zh: 眼前需要彼此，最后却只想自己赢：每次合作都要重新判断是否可信。
summary.en: Players need each other now but pursue their own victory, so cooperation is repeatedly renegotiated.

summary.zh: 花有限的建筑资源，让敌人多走几步、多挨几轮攻击。
summary.en: Spend limited building resources to make enemies walk farther under fire.

loop.en: Place obstacles to extend the route
Revise the layout where enemies escaped

summary.zh: 塔会自己开火，玩家决定它先解决哪一种威胁。
summary.en: The tower fires automatically; the player decides which threat it addresses first.

loop.zh: 观察队列里的不同威胁
loop.en: Inspect the different threats in the line

summary.zh: 主动缩短休息时间，用更危险的重叠进攻换取奖励。
summary.en: Shorten the rest period to exchange overlapping attacks for a reward.

loop.zh: 查看下一波与剩余时间
loop.en: Inspect the next wave and remaining interval

loop.zh: 处理重叠敌人并结算收益
loop.en: Handle overlapping enemies and collect the benefit

name.en: Invest by day, defend by night

summary.zh: 每次安全期都在决定：今天多赚钱，还是今晚更安全。
summary.en: Each safe period asks whether to earn more tomorrow or survive more safely tonight.

loop.en: Split spending between income and defense
Plan the next day from the result

name.en: Move a defender to the breach

summary.zh: 固定防线顾不过来时，玩家本人就是可以移动的最后一道补丁。
summary.en: When fixed defenses cannot cover everything, the player becomes a mobile reserve.

loop.en: Identify the lane likely to fail first
Move to the breach and intervene
Rotate elsewhere or retreat to safety

summary.zh: 先减速、再集中、再造成伤害，让几个普通陷阱一起发挥作用。
summary.en: Slow, gather and damage enemies so several simple traps work as a sequence.

loop.zh: 找出敌人必经的狭窄位置
loop.en: Find a narrow route enemies must cross

loop.zh: 安排控制与伤害的顺序

loop.en: Adjust spacing or repair a missing link

name.zh: 为不同敌人准备克制手段

summary.zh: 火力很高也可能打不动，先判断敌人需要哪一种处理方式。
summary.en: High damage can still be useless; first identify what kind of answer the enemy requires.

loop.en: Check the result against actual hits

summary.zh: 同样的钱，是把一个好位置变强，还是在另一处增加覆盖？
summary.en: Spend the same money on a stronger position or on coverage somewhere else.

loop.zh: 观察覆盖或输出是否改善
loop.en: Check whether coverage or damage improved

summary.zh: 塔建好了还不算完成，子弹断供时，再强的防线也会停火。
summary.en: A built turret is not a finished defense: it stops firing when ammunition runs out.

loop.zh: 战斗中观察消耗与补给

loop.en: Refill buffers or repair delivery bottlenecks

summary.zh: 成长到关键节点，只能选一条更擅长的路线。
summary.en: At a milestone, commit to one branch of expertise.

summary.zh: 成长跟随实际行为，常做的事情自然变成特长。
summary.en: Repeated actions build the corresponding skill.

loop.zh: 完成行动获得对应经验
利用新效率或改练别项
loop.en: Use the gain or train elsewhere

cases.gameZh: 上古卷轴5：天际 特别版

summary.zh: 保留已有成长，付出代价后换一种能力组合。
summary.en: Keep earned progress but pay to change its allocation.

loop.zh: 发现当前能力不合需求
查看能退回的投入和代价

name.zh: 失败也能带回成长资源

summary.zh: 这一趟没通关，也能为下一趟留下可用的提升。
summary.en: An unsuccessful attempt can still fund the next one.

name.zh: 失败后挑选下一位继承者

summary.zh: 每次重新出发先换个人，适应新角色的长处与毛病。
summary.en: Start the next attempt with a different mix of strengths and quirks.

loop.zh: 选一个适合当前目标的人

summary.zh: 主动放弃这一轮积累，换下一轮更快起步。
summary.en: Trade this cycle’s progress for a faster next cycle.

loop.zh: 比较继续推进与重置收益
确认保留与清空的内容

loop.en: Replay early stages with a bonus

summary.zh: 熟悉规则后，给同一套挑战再加一道限制。
summary.en: Add another constraint after mastering the base challenge.

loop.zh: 记录完成条件并继续加难

name.zh: 升级时从随机选项中挑一个

summary.zh: 每次升级给几项候选，玩家边打边决定成长方向。
summary.en: Each level offers a small random set that shapes the current build.

name.zh: 凑齐条件升级成新武器

summary.zh: 一路保留配套零件，等条件满足后把武器变成新形态。
summary.en: Keep the required pieces until a weapon can transform.

name.zh: 先研究前置，再解锁新技术

summary.zh: 研究不是单独等进度条，而是安排一条解锁路线。
summary.en: Research is a route through prerequisites, not just a timer.

loop.zh: 利用新能力支持后续研究
loop.en: Use it to support later research

name.zh: 死亡会损失练出的能力

summary.zh: 失败不只丢物品，还会损失一部分练习成果。
summary.en: Death can cost training as well as possessions.

name.zh: 懂了规则，就能跨过障碍

summary.zh: 角色没有变强，是玩家知道了一种原本就能用的做法。
summary.en: The character is unchanged; the player learns an action that was already possible.

loop.zh: 返回应用知识继续前进

summary.zh: 换一身衣服，就换了一张能去不同地方的通行证。
summary.en: Changing clothes changes where you are allowed to go.

loop.en: Use access to reach the goal

cases.game: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun

summary.zh: 让守卫走向你制造的声响，空出真正想走的路。
summary.en: Send a guard toward a sound to open the route you actually want.

summary.zh: 放倒守卫只是前半步，还得决定把留下的证据放哪儿。
summary.en: Taking down a guard is only half the task; the body still needs a destination.

loop.en: Move the body out of sight

summary.zh: 先给几名队员安排动作，再一口气处理互相照应的守卫。
summary.en: Queue several characters, then act together against guards watching one another.

cases.game: Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun

summary.zh: 地面上的明暗，决定哪里适合停留、哪里必须快速通过。
summary.en: Light and shadow tell you where to wait and where to cross quickly.

summary.zh: 先花一点时间看清另一侧，再决定要不要走进去。
summary.en: Spend a little time seeing the other side before stepping into it.

summary.zh: 摄像头既能发现你，也能成为你看见敌人的眼睛。
summary.en: A camera can expose you—or become your own lookout.

loop.en: Locate the device or control point
Use the new safety or information

name.zh: 进入藏身点再择机出来

summary.zh: 柜子提供暂时安全，却把自由行动换成了等待出口时机。
summary.en: A hiding spot offers safety in exchange for waiting for a safe exit.

summary.zh: 没杀死的守卫会醒来，你要花人手看住他，还是赶快离开？
summary.en: An unconscious guard may recover: assign someone to hold them, or leave quickly?

summary.zh: 先读懂物件与巡逻的关系，再让环境完成最后一步。
summary.en: Read props and patrol routes, then let the environment deliver the final action.
